resources.string: Definition: Motion along a straight path where the object covers equal distances in equal time intervals.
Velocity (v): Constant magnitude and direction. Formula: v = s / t\nDistance: s = v * t | Time: t = s / v
Definition: The object moves along a straight path with constant acceleration.

Starting from rest (v0 = 0):
- Velocity: v = a * t
- Distance: s = (a / 2) * t^2
- v^2 = 2 * a * s
Definition: The object moves along a circular path with constant speed. Period (T), Frequency (f = 1 / T).
Tangential speed: v = (2 * r * pi) / T = 2 * r * pi * f\nAngular velocity: omega = (2 * pi) / T\nCentripetal acceleration: a_cp = v^2 / r
Definition: Vertically downward motion starting from rest (v0 = 0) with air resistance neglected.

Gravitational acceleration (g ≈ 9.81 m/s²):
- Velocity: v = g * t
- Height: h = (g / 2) * t^2
- Time: t = sqrt(2 * h / g)
